## Samaritans Radar

Scores draw on a grey-literature case study [@responsibledata_radar] and a
contemporary news report [@irishtimes2014]. People whose tweets were scanned
had no role and were not informed (A1–A5 and B2 = ○); the only role belonged to
app users, who were prompted to reach out to the people flagged (A6 = ◐). The
case is therefore classed as data subjects only. Monitoring was opt-out by
default with no consent from the people monitored (B6 = ○). The app was
withdrawn after public objection, suspended after nine days and closed after
five months (C3 and D1 = ○), so the verdict is failure.
